repos_data.description: vacuum is the worlds fastest and most versatile OpenAPI, AsyncAPI & JSON Schema linter, docs generator and toolkit. It tears through API specs at light speed. 100% compatible with Spectral rulesets, and OpenAPI 3.0, 3.1 and 3.2
⚡A lightweight, framework-agnostic OpenAPI 3.x specification builder for Go.
Automatically generate RESTful API documentation for GO projects - aligned with Open API Specification standard
